_comment: AIRLOCK V2 hook config for Cursor. Cursor does NOT have an event-driven hook surface (per agent-integration survey Section 3.1). The closest analogues are: (a) Shell() allow-list permissions, and (b) custom file-watcher hooks via ~/.cursor/hooks/ if supported by the Cursor version. We provide BOTH paths: a permissions block (always supported) and a hooks block (only effective if the user's Cursor version supports it — currently 2026.07.08-0c04a8a which does NOT have a hooks field).

permissions._comment: Add these entries to ~/.cursor/cli-config.json permissions.allow. Once the agent has permission to call airlock-v2-hook.sh, it can be invoked by name from any tool call.
permissions._agent_instruction: Additionally, add this to your project AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md for Cursor: 'After every Edit/Write tool call, run /Users/kooshapari/CodeProjects/Phenotype/repos/_phenofleet-decisions/airlock-v2/hooks/airlock-v2-hook.sh to commit work-in-progress.'

hooks._comment: Cursor 2026.07.08 does NOT natively support this block — but provides the canonical shape for future versions. Do NOT add this to cli-config.json until Cursor ships hooks support.

afterFileEdit.description: Airlock V2: auto-commit + push wip branch after every Cursor file edit

stop.description: Airlock V2: final reconciliation + push on Cursor agent stop
